name: Invisibility
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

A creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as they continue to wear or carry it. The spell ends if the target attacks or casts a spell.

Roll Lore to see if you trigger any additional effects.

Describe how they turn invisible.
successes:
✨: If the target attacks, the spell only ends if the attack hits.

🌞: The spell does not end if the target attacks or casts a spell.

💀: The spell fails to make the target invisible. Instead, a random object they are wearing or carrying becomes permanently invisible. Check a condition.
